🏷️ Tavern & Shop Names

Ten names a roll. Click a name to copy it, or ☆ to keep it for later.

    📌 Kept names (0)

      Kept names stay in this browser, so a refresh won't lose them, and they never leave your device.
      The address bar holds the roll's dice seed: 🔗 Copy Link shares the same ten names, and Back returns to the previous roll. Shop names come from the same tables as Merchant's Row.

      🗺️ Weather & Travel Day

      Pick the land and the season, then take the road one day at a time: the weather, what happens on the way, and how far the party gets.

      📜 The road so far

        Distances follow the travel pace rules of the System Reference Document 5.1 (CC-BY 4.0): pace, difficult terrain, forced marches, and galloping. Effects marked ruling are the Gazette's suggestions, not official rules.
        Journey length 0 means an open road with no destination. The address bar holds the journey's seed and the day, so 🔗 Copy Link shares the whole trip so far, and Back steps to the day before. Changing the pace or hours keeps the weather.
